items.title: Bullish Natural Gas Storage Meets Bearish Reality
items.summary: Natural gas futures edged lower Friday as traders looked beyond Thursday's smaller-than-expected US Energy Information Administration (EIA) storage injection, refocusing on elevated production, softer LNG export demand and a mixed weather outlook.

items.title: ExxonMobil Sees Permian Pipelines Clearing Way for More Associated Gas
items.summary: Permian Basin natural gas takeaway is reaching the point where the market can “clear,” potentially unlocking more oil production and the associated gas that comes with it, ExxonMobil CEO Darren Woods said Friday.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Teeter Intraday as Supply and Demand Butt Heads
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures seesawed into late morning on Friday as traders juxtaposed a lean storage print and forecasts for solid weather demand against elevated levels of total supply.

items.title: ‘Extreme-Heat Domes’ Blunting Price Impact of Canada, Mexico LNG Weakness
items.summary: Struggling LNG feedgas demand on the US Gulf Coast has captured headlines in recent weeks, a trend that also is occurring simultaneously in Canada and Mexico.

items.title: Natural Gas Storage Draws Across South Central, West Punctuate Impact of Heat Waves
items.summary: Natural gas storage levels slipped across the West as extreme heat gripped major markets and sent natural gas demand upward to meet cooling needs.

items.title: Tourmaline Deferring Canada Activity as Natural Gas Markets Still Not ‘Buoyant’ on Price
items.summary: Canada’s top natural gas producer Tourmaline is scaling back upstream activity as the price of natural gas in Western Canada continues to remain doggedly suppressed.

items.title: Western Heat Shields Natural Gas Forwards as National Prices Retreat
items.summary: Natural gas forwards gave back last week’s heat-driven gains during the July 22–29 trading period, with a broad sell-off sparing only Western points where record desert temperatures kept buyers on their toes.

items.title: Enterprise Adds Natural Gas Plants as Permian ‘Growing at Speed of Light’
items.summary: Enterprise Products Partners approved two more Permian Basin natural gas processing plants as executives said about 2 Bcf/d of curtailed production could return, refill new takeaway capacity and pressure Waha prices again before 2027.
